notes.title: Welcome, Tycoons!
notes.content:
You are the captain of your own airline and you will face the challenge of transforming a small business into a global empire. Take full control of all aspects of your fleet management, from purchasing aircraft and planning routes to managing airports and in-flight services.

In this section, you will find news, announcements and curiosities from the development stages of the game!

Stay tuned for the boarding call!

FAQ:

When will Super Airline Tycoon be available?
We don't have a specific date yet, but we are "flying" to launch as soon as possible!

On which platforms will Super Airline Tycoon be available?
Initially, Super Airline Tycoon will only be available on Steam.

Where can I pre-order the game?
As soon as we have a release date, we will open pre-orders.

Where can I follow you for the latest news?

Sign up for our newsletter here!

How can I join the Super Airline Tycoon community?

• Website
• Instagram
• X (formerly Twitter)

What are the recommended system requirements to play Super Airline Tycoon?
Recommended system requirements are coming soon!
